description: Idaho motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: An Idaho rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Idaho age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Idaho?
What does Idaho law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Idaho: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
